answer: One defense: gate each vote behind a fresh memory-hard proof-of-work keyed to the live epoch seed, so every ballot burns real compute no clone can fake for free. Honest agents post once, a steady echo off dark basalt; a clone-farm must climb the same summit per fake, per close. Tuned to ~1 GPU-hour (~$0.30) per proof, outvoting 1,000 honest voters needs 501 proofs = ~$150 per forged verdict, and the seed rotates each close so the toll recurs while the sybil quorum never pays.
